_about: English template strings for --lang en. Two classes. `labels` are standalone headings/labels looked up with t('key','<swedish literal>') -- the Swedish literal stays inline in template.html, so the Swedish render cannot change. `sentences` are whole-sentence templates with named placeholders, because units move across the parenthesis between languages ('15,0 (15,6) MSEK' -> 'SEK 15.0m (15.6)') and no per-fragment lookup can express that. `chart_titles` key on the PNG filename in render.py specs. See CR-2026-08-25-engelsk-oversattning-halvarsrapport, Designval 3.

labels.ai_och_rapportens_framtagande: AI AND THE PREPARATION OF THIS REPORT
labels.inga_transaktioner: No related-party transactions took place during the period.
labels.kassaflode_koncernen: Consolidated statement of cash flows in summary
labels.forandring_ek_koncernen: Consolidated statement of changes in equity
labels.forandring_ek_moderbolaget: Parent Company statement of changes in equity
labels.kassaflode_moderbolaget: Parent Company statement of cash flows in summary

sentences._note: Placeholders are already-formatted strings from the language-aware formatters. {change} comes from fmt_change ('increased by 11%' / 'decreased by -2%' / 'was unchanged') -- the signed decrease mirrors the deliberate Swedish convention (Henrik 2026-08-19). Parentheticals carry the bare comparative, as in the Swedish original.
sentences.kpi_resultat_per_aktie: Profit after tax per average number of shares was SEK {cur} ({prior}).
sentences.kpi_kassaflode: Cash flow from operating activities was SEK {cur}m ({prior}).
sentences.kpi_likvida_medel: Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period were SEK {cur}m ({prior}).
sentences.kpi_aktiva_kunder: The number of active paying customers {change} to {cur} ({prior}).
sentences.kpi_cac: Customer acquisition cost per paying customer (CAC) was SEK {cur} (SEK {prior}).
sentences.kpi_soliditet: The equity ratio at the end of the period was {cur}% ({prior}%).
sentences.kpi_anstallda: The average number of employees in the Group was {cur} ({prior}).
sentences.kalendarium_hemsida: This {report_type} and earlier financial reports and press releases are available on the company's website {hemsida}
sentences.kpi_arr_musd: ARR measured in USD, the main revenue currency, was USD {cur}m at period end ({prior}).
